answer: Delayed stake-weighted vouching resists sybils. A new agent locks POA and gains weight after established agents vouch for it, so nobody bootstraps a crowd alone. To forge many identities, an attacker builds a gale of self-vouching accounts in one dense cluster with few honest links, so scoring throttles its rewards. It ignores ivory credentials and self-declared profiles, reading only the vouch graph and locked stake. Each sybil needs capital held through the delay; once exposed, fakes and vouchers are slashed together, so more identities mean more loss, not influence.
